tagline: Reset the entire league and become the general manager of one of six teams.
description: Fantasy Draft resets the league into a brand-new six-team universe, separate from the real LSL season. You take over as general manager of one team while the CPU runs the other five, starting with a snake draft and running through a six-week season into the playoffs.

season.note: The calendar advances day by day. Games are simulated automatically whenever Saturday arrives.
